title: From Algorithmic Marginalization to AI-Mediated Re-Centering: Can Culturally Grounded AI Bring Hakka Language and Culture Back into Mainstream Society?

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes an empirical framework to evaluate linguistic homogenization, dialect fidelity, and functional exclusion by comparing model performance across minority languages (e.g., Hakka) versus dominant languages, and by using paired comparisons of original and AI-rewritten texts to measure unrequested standardization.

Proposes measuring algorithmic cultural marginalization by analyzing AI-generated or translated texts for the retention of cultural markers, situated knowledge, and social meaning, specifically tracking substitutions, omissions, and loss of cultural nuances compared to human-authored expressions.
